owner: Dept D/C worker (child session 2026-11-08, D-025); Pre-registration Officer: Director's brief
hypothesis: A pre-registered hypothesis under test, not an edge claim. Hong-Wang (2000) periodic market closure: inventory risk over the US cash close makes each index's close-to-open move overshoot relative to its peers, and the next cash session reverses the relative overnight winners and losers (Della Corte, Kosowski and Wang, 'Market Closure and Short-Term Reversal', CO-OC on 35 CME futures incl. S&P500, NASDAQ, DJIA, S&P400, NIKKEI 225, 1982-2014). This is the CME-futures version of candidates.md rank 1 (AS C-4-01); its index-CFD version Q-0007 FAILED with gross +0.01 bp/day (t 0.01), so the prior is low (D-021). Sign fixed: LONG the future with the most negative standardised overnight return, SHORT the one with the most positive.
rules: Data: Databento GLBX.MDP3 ohlcv-1h, stype_in=continuous, symbol <ROOT>.v.0 (front by volume), purchased 2026-11-08 by batch job (estimate row in data/databento_spend_ledger.csv first); ingested to DATA_ROOT/derived/<dataset>.parquet with ts = bar OPEN in UTC, columns open/high/low/close/volume/instrument_id; rows >= 2025-01-01 go only to DATA_ROOT/holdout/<dataset>_holdout.parquet. A 1h bar exists only if the contract traded in that hour. Every ET time below is America/New_York via zoneinfo; because ET is a whole-hour offset from UTC, 'the bar opening HH:00 ET' is exactly one Databento bar. Roll rule (ex ante): a return between two prices is used only if both bars carry the same instrument_id (the .v.0 mapping changes at a session boundary); otherwise the observation is ineligible and counted. Universe U (tie order) = ES, NQ, YM, EMD, NKD. Trading days d = full XNYS sessions (exchange_calendars) whose previous XNYS session d-1 is also a full session (early closes on d or d-1 skipped). Reference close C_i(d-1) = CLOSE of the bar opening 15:00 ET on d-1 (last trade before 16:00 ET). Signal price S_i(d) = CLOSE of the bar opening 09:00 ET on d (last trade before 10:00 ET). CO_i(d) = ln(S_i(d)/C_i(d-1)). z_i(d) = CO_i(d)/s_i(d), s_i(d) = sqrt(EWMA, centre of mass 60, of CO_i^2 over the instrument's prior eligible days through d-1), at least 40 prior observations. ENTRY at the OPEN of the bar opening 10:00 ET on d (first trade at or after 10:00:00, after the signal bar has closed). EXIT at the CLOSE of the bar opening 15:00 ET on d (last trade before 16:00 ET; inside every intraday-futures deadline, Topstep 16:10 ET the earliest). Eligibility of i on d: the four bars (C, S, entry, exit) exist and carry one instrument_id; s_i and sigma_i defined. Trade only if at least 4 instruments are eligible. LONG L = argmin z, SHORT S = argmax z (ties: earlier in U), every eligible day, no threshold. Day P&L (fraction of account) = w_L*ln(P_L(exit)/P_L(entry)) - w_S*ln(P_S(exit)/P_S(entry)) - costs. No stops, targets or pyramiding; flat every day.
parameters: signal C 16:00(d-1) -> S 10:00(d) (1h bar closes); entry 10:00 bar open; exit 15:00 bar close (=16:00); z = CO / EWMA(com 60) RMS; min 4 eligible; +-25% neighbours (fixed now): entry at the OPEN of the 11:00 ET bar (hold 5 h, x0.83, the nearest 1h grid point), exit at the CLOSE of the 14:00 ET bar (hold 5 h), EWMA centre of mass 45 and 75; one-bar delay variant = entry at the OPEN of the 11:00 ET bar; volatility terciles = ES trailing 20-day s.d. of 16:00-to-16:00 log returns (IS bounds)
instruments: CME ES, NQ, YM (CBOT), EMD, NKD (USD Nikkei) front futures; micros MES/MNQ/MYM for account sizing (same prices)
holding: 6 h intraday (10:00 -> 16:00 ET), one long + one short leg per day, about 245 days/yr (about 490 round trips/yr)
data_sha256: PINNED AT INGEST (data bought after this registration): the sha256 of each derived parquet is written to data/manifest.csv before the first gateway read, and the result file prints manifest = recomputed for every dataset
vol_scaler: Leg weight w_i = (0.10/sqrt(252))/sigma_i, sigma_i = EWMA (centre of mass 60 eligible days, at least 40) s.d. of the instrument's own 10:00->16:00 ET log return through d-1; no cap/floor; the pair is not beta-hedged.
cost_model: 1x per side on each leg's notional (contract point value x entry/exit price), briefs/00-common.md floors: ES 0.30 pt x $50 + $2.50; NQ 0.25 pt x $20 + $2.50; YM 1.2 pt x $5 + $2.50; NKD 6 pt x $5 + $2.50 (1.2 ticks, as ES); EMD 0.20 pt x $100 + $2.50 (2 ticks: thin book); charged at entry and exit on top of the trade-price return. 2x run attached (every per-side cost doubled).
decision_rule: Gate v2 on the OOS window only, exactly one read through qe.gateway.load(id,'oos') per dataset in one run (the IS read for EWMA warm-up precedes it): pass iff (1) the deciding one-sided t (minimum of iid, Newey-West and the event/day-clustered t of the net-1x series) >= 3.6807 AND the stationary-bootstrap (>= 430,000 draws) one-sided lower bound at alpha 0.05/430 > 0; (2) net-2x mean > 0 (criterion 3); (3) criteria 4 and 7 of PARAMETERS.md: at least 70% of OOS calendar years positive, no single year > 50% of a positive net, at least 2 of 3 volatility terciles (bounds from IS) positive, the +-25% neighbours listed in parameters all net-positive, and the one-bar-delay variant net-positive; (4) Red Team and re-implementation sign-off; (5) hold-out read on the *_holdout datasets in the restated one-sided tolerance form with h = decay_haircut. Verdict mechanically: PASS Gate 3 if (1)-(3) hold; NEAR-MISS if the deciding t is within 1.0 of the bar (t >= 2.6807) with the bootstrap 5th percentile of the mean > 0; else FAIL (refuted under the row's rule). Before the OOS read, on IS only: the truncation harness (delete every bar after the entry instant; the decision must not change) and the perturbation harness (1% noise on post-entry bars) must pass on >= 30 sampled IS events, and a planted look-ahead must fail. The result file prints criterion-4 power and the joint figure for its own OOS length. Series: the per-traded-day net P&L (one observation per day; NW lag 10). Concentration also requires no unordered instrument pair > 50% of a positive net. Sub-periods (information only): 2015-2019, 2020-03..2022-04, 2022-05.. (daily 0DTE).
notes: Source: research/triage-2026-11-08.md class C #1 (AS C-4-01), prescreen-2026-11-06 #1, D-021. EVIDENCE WINDOW: DKW, 35 CME futures daily open/close Jul 1982-Dec 2014; OOS 2015-2024 untouched (not derivative); IS 2010-06..2014-12 overlaps and is IS by declaration. Adaptation to 1h bars (disclosed): the signal uses the 10:00 ET price instead of the 09:30 open (the first 30 minutes of the cash session are inside the 'overnight' leg) and the hold is 10:00 -> 16:00; entering at the bar open right after the signal bar's close assumes sub-second execution, which the one-bar-delay variant (11:00 entry) bounds. Closed families: H0012/H0017 (S&P time-series gap fade) and E1-08..10 adjacent, not inside (relative, cross-index). Q-0007 (CFD twin, FAIL, gross 0.01 bp/day) is the same family on other data: this row is the second count of family xs-closure-reversal (2 of 5). OOS 10.0 years: bar 1.16 annual Sharpe; criterion-4 power 0.86/1.00/1.00 at true Sharpe 1.5/2.0/2.4; joint (criteria 3+4+7, costs 1/3 of gross) about 0.72/0.85/0.91. HONEST PRIOR about 0.05 (Q-0007 zero gross); expected passes about 0.03. Firm clauses: intraday futures, flat 16:00 ET (Topstep 16:10 ET auto-flatten the earliest); two opposite positions in different products is not same-instrument hedging (verify Tradeify/Lucid wording); 10:00 ET releases (ISM etc.) coincide with the entry: at MFFU Rapid/Pro and Lucid Daily the +-2 min window bans the entry on release days - reported as a firm sensitivity (no count), entry at 10:00 is kept as registered for Topstep/Bulenox/TradeDay.
